Name: Dungeon Secrets
Author: Mulaag53
Description:
[size=5][b]DUNGEON SECRETS[/b][/size][i]Those boarded-up doorways in the Mines were never just decoration.[/i] Every so often a mine floor has a doorway that's been nailed shut or buried under a cave-in. In vanilla you just walk past them. Now they give way to a bomb. Blow one open and the rubble comes tumbling out. Behind it is a small, forgotten chamber: maybe a vein of ore, maybe a seam of coal, maybe a cache the old miners left behind. There's always a way down, so a secret room never costs you progress. [size=4][b]New in 2.0: special rooms[/b][/size] Every so often, the doorway opens onto something rarer than a chamber.
[list]
[*][b]Hot springs.[/b] A steaming grotto with a waterfall, a pool and stone steps leading down into the water. Walk in and you change into your swimsuit and swim. Inside a hot spring the clock stands still, and your health and energy slowly come back, faster while you're soaking. A true safe zone. (Single-player.) [/*]
[*][b]Crystal springs.[/b] A rarer hot spring, its walls studded with glinting gems and lit by glowing crystal clusters along the shore. [/*]
[*][b]Gemstone caves.[/b] Walls glittering with gems and ore, crystal clusters glowing in every colour, and gem and geode nodes to mine, suited to how deep you are. [/*]
[/list]There are 24 hand-picked layouts (12 hot springs, 6 crystal springs and 6 gem caves), each with its own shape: ledges with streams tumbling over a cliff, pools fed straight from the back wall, twin pools joined by a stream, islands, stepping stones, a timber-shored dividing wall... You always come in through a tunnel in the left wall. Whatever floor you find one on, the room is drawn in that floor's own art, from the brown upper Mines to the ice, lava and Skull Cavern sandstone. Roughly one plain room in seven becomes a special room, a little more often the deeper you go: hot springs (a quarter of them crystal springs) and gemstone caves. [size=4][b]How it works[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Any explosive works.[/b] A cherry bomb, bomb or mega bomb opens the doorway if the blast reaches it. [/*]
[*][b]Every doorway spills 50 stone[/b] (adjustable in config.json). [/*]
[*][b]What's behind it is rolled the moment it blows[/b], from how deep you are and the bomber's luck (daily luck and any luck buffs):
[list]
[*][b]Ore vein:[/b] the floor's ore with a little of the tier below it, plus the odd gem or geode node. Deep floors can roll diamond and mystic stones, and in Skull Cavern the share of iridium grows the deeper you go. [/*]
[*][b]Coal seam:[/b] coal nodes, plus a few geode nodes. [/*]
[*][b]Miners' cache:[/b] one to three treasure chests of ore, bars, gems, geodes and bombs to suit the floor. [/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Step through[/b] by interacting with the opened doorway. It's a tight squeeze, and there's no squeezing back out. [/*]
[*][b]The chamber[/b] is a small room built from the floor's own tiles, so it matches wherever you found it, from the brown upper Mines to the ice floors, the lava floors and the Skull Cavern sandstone. [/*]
[*][b]The only way out is down:[/b] a ladder in the middle of the room, or in Skull Cavern a shaft that drops you several floors, just like the vanilla ones. [/*]
[*][b]Old workrooms.[/b] Doorways with minecart tracks running into them lead to an abandoned miners' workroom. A working furnace and workbench stand against the back wall (bolted down, so they can't be taken), next to a chest of leftover supplies. The tracks run right up to the ladder. [/*]
[*][b]Ice caves.[/b] On the frozen floors (40-69), the open cave mouths you sometimes pass were always leading somewhere. No bomb needed: walk up to one, climb down, and see what's hiding inside. [/*]
[*][b]Cracked brickwork.[/b] On floors 70-79, the cracks running through the brick walls give way to a bomb too, and behind the masonry is a natural ice cave. [/*]
[*][b]The occasional lantern[/b] still hangs on the wall and lights the room. The room takes the lighting of the floor you came from, so on dark floors the lanterns are the only light. [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Balance[/b][/size] The goal is a nice find, not a jackpot. Veins hold 4 to 18 nodes, which break with your pickaxe like any others. Caches use modest stacks scaled to the floor, and there are no prismatic shards or other rare-only items in the loot tables. Luck nudges the odds of a cache and the size of a vein; it doesn't break them. [size=4][b]Where the doorways are[/b][/size] There are two kinds: the [b]boarded door[/b] (leads to a plain chamber) and the [b]caved-in shaft entrance with tracks[/b] (leads to a workroom). They appear on these floors:
[list]
[*]Mines 1-39 and 80-119: both kinds [/*]
[*]Mines 40-69 (ice): boarded doors, plus open ice cave mouths you can walk straight into [/*]
[*]Mines 70-79 (brick): cracks in the brick walls [/*]
[*]Skull Cavern: shaft entrances, plus both kinds on dinosaur floors [/*]
[*]The dangerous mines from Qi's challenge: both kinds, except on the ice floors [/*]
[/list]On some floors (dark Skull Cavern and slime floors) the game draws the same spots as signs, ice or brick, so those aren't openable. Floor 120 and the Quarry Mine are left alone. [size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or newer [/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or newer [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI. [/*]
[*]Unzip the download into your [b]Mods[/b] folder. [/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI. [/*]
[/list]To uninstall, delete the [i]Dungeon Secrets[/i] folder. Nothing is added to your save. [size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]StoneYield[/b] (default 50): stone spilled by each blasted doorway. Set it in config.json, which is created the first time you run the game with the mod. [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Translations[/b][/size] Dungeon Secrets supports translation through SMAPI's i18n system. All of its text lives in [i]Dungeon Secrets/i18n/default.json[/i]. To translate it, copy that file to the language's code (for example [i]es.json[/i], [i]de.json[/i], [i]fr.json[/i], [i]pt.json[/i], [i]ru.json[/i], [i]zh.json[/i], [i]ja.json[/i] or [i]ko.json[/i]), translate the text on the right of each line, and SMAPI will use it automatically when the game is set to that language. The shaft and ladder messages already use the game's own translated text. Translations are very welcome: send me the file, or upload it as a translation on Nexus and I'll link it here. [size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley Expanded. [/*]
[*]Doorways are found by the game's own mine tiles. Mods that replace the mine maps can change which doorways appear. [/*]
[*]The opened-doorway art and the chamber are built from the vanilla mine tilesheets. With a mine recolor installed, an opened doorway may not quite match its surroundings. [/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] the private chamber is single-player only, and so are the special rooms. In multiplayer, a blown doorway spills its spoils on the spot and opens a ladder (or a shaft in Skull Cavern) right there. Multiplayer is untested so far. [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Console commands (for testing)[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]dsec_list[/b]: lists the blocked doorways on the current floor [/*]
[*][b]dsec_open[/b] [i][ore|coal|treasure|spring|crystal|gems] [room][/i]: opens every doorway on the floor as if bombed; the optional word forces the room type, and for special rooms you can name one (e.g. [i]dsec_open spring 25[/i]) [/*]
[*][b]dsec_rooms[/b]: lists the special rooms [/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size] Mod by Mulaag. All art is built from Stardew Valley's own mine tiles and sprites; the gem-studded walls are our own take, inspired by the mineral cave in FlashShifter's Grandpa's Farm. Dungeon Secrets is a fan-made mod and is not affiliated with or endorsed by ConcernedApe. [size=4][b]Changelog[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]2.0.1[/b]: translation support. All of the mod's text now lives in i18n/default.json, so it can be translated into any language the game supports. [/*]
[*][b]2.0.0[/b]: special rooms: hot springs (a safe zone where time stands still, with swimming and health and energy recovery), crystal springs and gemstone caves. 24 hand-picked layouts drawn in each floor's own art. New console command dsec_rooms; dsec_open can force a special room. [/*]
[*][b]1.3.0[/b]: pre-opened ice cave mouths (floors 40-69) and blowable brick cracks (floors 70-79). [/*]
[*][b]1.2.0[/b]: wall lanterns; fixed walking through walls and the off-centre camera. [/*]
[*][b]1.1.0[/b]: entry nook, smoothed bottom wall, abandoned workrooms behind the track doorways. [/*]
[*][b]1.0.0[/b]: first release. [/*]
[/list]Bug reports and ideas are very welcome. Please include your SMAPI log ([url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url]) and the floor you were on.

Manifest.Name: Dungeon Secrets
Manifest.Description: Blow open the boarded and caved-in doorways in the Mines and Skull Cavern. Every one spills stone; behind it is a small chamber with an ore vein, a coal seam or a miners' cache, and a way down.
Manifest.Author: Mulaag
